post.description: Generate an AI-powered answer based on the provided context. Returns the answer along with the knowledge-base sources used to produce it.

200.description: Returns an AI generated answer and related sources for the given context.

400.description:
Only one context item is allowed (We will allow multiple ones this in the future).

Invalid parameters

404.description: No matching knowledge base entries for the given context.

post.description: Submit user feedback (positive or negative) for a previously generated AI answer, identified by its trace ID.

parameters.name: traceId
parameters.description: traceId of the conversation to provide feedback for

instanceId.description: remberg id of the object that should be used to limit the context

type.description: type of the object that should be used to limit the context

question.description: Question that should be answered by the request

context.description: Additional information to narrow the context that shall be used to answer the question (will use all available information if left empty)

sourceType.description: type of the source (e.g. file or ticket)

text.description: text snippet of the source that was used to generate the answer

fileId.description: remberg id of the file where the information can be found in

fileName.description: name of the file where the information can be found in

page.description: page on which the information can be found

sourceType.description: type of the source (e.g. file or ticket)

text.description: text snippet of the source that was used to generate the answer

ticketId.description: remberg id of the ticket where the information can be found in

title.description: title of the ticket where the information can be found in

traceId.description: traceId to keep track of the conversation. Can be e.g. used to submit feedback

question.description: question that was answered by the request

answer.description: generated answer to the given question

sources.description: list of sources that have been used to generate the answer

score.description: Indicator for confidence of the answer, value between 0 and 1

comment.description: Qualitative feedback to explain the score or give additional information to improve future responses
